name: Michigan

office.name: MDOT Transport Permits Unit (MiTRIP via MDOT Permit Gateway)

fees.note: T-2 K / MCL 257.725(5): $15 single trip for over-dimension, legal weight. Valid up to 5 days; one return move may be included.
T-2 K / MCL 257.725(4): $50 single trip for over-dimension and/or overweight. Grouped with the $15 oversize fee: one permit, the higher fee applies.

restrictions.text: Daylight only (1/2 hr before sunrise to 1/2 hr after sunset), Monday-Friday (T-2 H applies to every permit). Exception: loads not over 10' wide, 14' high and 90' long may also move all day Saturday and Sunday until 3 p.m. when weekend travel is selected in MiTRIP (not mobile homes).

No movement from noon the day before until daylight the day after New Year's, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas; if the holiday falls on Friday or Monday the ban covers the whole 3-day weekend. See MDOT's yearly holiday table for exact dates.
Holiday restrictions above also apply to overweight permits. No overweight permits during spring weight-restriction period (except public emergency).
No permits for widths over 14 ft during the spring weight-restriction period (except public emergency).
When listed on the permit (special provision 15): no movement 7-9 AM or 3-6 PM in Genesee, Ingham, Jackson, Kalamazoo, Kent, Macomb, Muskegon, Oakland, Saginaw, Washtenaw and Wayne counties.

travel.holidays: No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend
closures: sun from 15:00: Weekend travel ends Sunday 3 P.M. (loads within 10' W, 14' H, 90' L)
travel.note: T-2 H: daylight Monday-Friday; MDOT FAQ: Saturday all day and Sunday until 3 P.M. for loads within 10' wide, 14' high, 90' long.

travel.weekends: No travel on Saturday or Sunday
travel.note: Over 10 ft wide: no weekend movement.

travel.weekends: No travel on Saturday or Sunday
travel.note: Over 14 ft high: no weekend movement.

travel.note: Over 90 ft long: no weekend movement.

notes: Escorts follow a secondary source (J. J. Keller): MDOT assigns them per permit through numbered special provisions (11 = rear escort, 12 = front escort with height pole when over 14'6", 14 = police supervision) and its public T-2 guide does not publish thresholds for general loads. Police supervision (provision 14) is not modeled. Check the MiTRIP permit.

Superloads (> 16' wide, > 15' high, > 150' long): MiTRIP application + shipper letter + Route Survey Certification (Form 2465), up to 10 business days. When MDOT requires a police escort, MSP Operations (517-241-8000) also inspects vehicle, load and driver before the move.

Legal weight in Michigan is axle-based (up to 11 axles; gross can exceed 80,000 lb on Michigan-legal configurations). MiTRIP assigns fees from actual axle weights, so a load over 80,000 lb may still be weight-legal - verify overweight status per axle configuration.
Fees under MCL 257.725(5) may be CPI-adjusted once a year; T-2 (10/2023) still lists $15/$50.

MDOT permits cover state trunklines (I-, US-, M- routes) only; county roads and city streets need separate permits. Mackinac Bridge, International Bridge (Sault Ste. Marie), Blue Water and Ambassador bridges need 24-hour advance contact; Mackinac Bridge requires its own escort and daylight crossing.
